case.title: Design: The More actions button and its menu look as in the design
case.custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-A} (for example Admin ShopView), an Owner or Admin user whose role has Work orders > View, Work orders > Create & Edit and See financial data, at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
  • Your browser window is 1440 px wide, with the browser zoom at 100%.
  • The design pictures DC-12-board-card-hover-button-light-1440.png, DC-12-board-card-menu-light-1440.png and DC-12-tech-row-menu-locked-light-1440.png are open beside the app at 100% zoom (actual size); they are attached to this case.
  • In the design pictures the names, numbers, dates and amounts are sample data, and the rank numbers (1, 2, 3 …) beside rows and cards are left out of this release, so do not compare those.
  • The design's menu words read "Reassign Lead Tech" and "Unassign"; the case follows the PRD's words, so compare only the look and the place of the button and the menu. The design's locked note "Invoiced · can't be reassigned" is the PRD's tooltip too.
  • Technician {Technician-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST DC12 Rae Menu) is an active technician at {Location-A}.
  • Customer {Customer-A} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST DC12 More Actions") is used by this case only.
  • Approved work order {Work-order-1} (for example S10043-17834) for {Customer-A} is led by {Technician-A}.
  • Work order {Work-order-2} (for example S10043-17835) for {Customer-A} is Invoiced and led by {Technician-A}.
  • On the Work Orders page nothing is chosen in any filter (if the Asset on Site chip shows Yes or No, click the x on the chip), Assigned to me is off, Search is empty and density is Regular (the default).
case.custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, click the All tab and click Board View in the display switcher.
  2. Look at {Work-order-1}'s card without hovering it.
  3. Hover {Work-order-1}'s card.
  4. Click the three-dot button that appears.
  5. Press Escape.
  6. Click Tech View in the display switcher.
  7. Hover {Work-order-1}'s row.
  8. Click the three-dot button at the right end of the row.
  9. Press Escape.
  10. Hover {Work-order-2}'s row and click its three-dot button.
  11. Hover the greyed-out Reassign lead technician item.
case.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: no three-dot button shows on the card.
  • Step 3: the card's border darkens and a soft shadow appears, and a small white square button with three dots appears. “The … button sits at the card’s top right, to the left of the status label, and never covers it: the full status stays readable while the button shows.” (PRD version 76, S3-R13)
  • Step 4: a white menu opens below the button, lined up with the button's right edge, with Reassign lead technician as its first item and an outline icon before each item, as in the menu design picture.
  • Step 7: the row turns light grey and a three-dot button appears at the right end of the row.
  • Step 8: the same kind of white menu opens below the button, lined up with its right edge.
  • Step 10: the menu's Reassign lead technician item is greyed out and cannot be chosen, as in the locked-menu design picture, and Unassign is greyed out too.
  • Step 11: the tooltip reads "Invoiced · can’t be reassigned".

Source — where this behaviour comes from

Epic SV-10043; stories SV-10046 (Story 3, Board View), SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign the lead technician); PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 68 (19 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S3-R13, S3-R14, S4-R4 and S4-N6, read 19 Oct 2026; Claude Design project "Work Orders" (Branko Cicovic), export of 14 Oct 2026, board "Work Orders.dc.html", states states__work-orders__board-card-menu-button-over-badge__light__1440, states__work-orders__board-card-menu__light__1440 and states__work-orders__tech-row-menu-locked__light__1440 (design pictures DC-12-board-card-hover-button-light-1440.png, DC-12-board-card-menu-light-1440.png, DC-12-tech-row-menu-locked-light-1440.png, rendered from that export at the width in the name), read 14 Oct 2026. Where the PRD says nothing about the look, the design is the source. Source-verified 19 October 2026. PRD version 76 (26 Oct 2026, Chris Ward) read 26 Oct 2026 for S3-R13. Last checked against QA branch sv11545 (build v26.43.1-a53a4ac) on 10/26/2026, and step 3 also on production (build v26.43.1-9af7270) on 10/26/2026.

Where the … button sits: the design picture shows it over the right end of the status label, but the PRD now places it beside the label (version 76, S3-R13), and this case follows the PRD. Chris Ward, on SV-11753, 26 Oct 2026: “Option 1: accept it as built. The … button sits beside the status label, so the full status stays readable while hovering, and it matches production. Please pass the test.” This also answers Ahtasham Amjad's question of 14 Oct 2026. The design's menu words differ from the PRD's; this case follows the PRD. Since PRD version 68 the locked tooltip is the design's words, “Invoiced · can’t be reassigned”.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R13 (version 76): “Reveal the card’s more-actions overlay on hover or keyboard focus. The … button sits at the card’s top right, to the left of the status label, and never covers it: the full status stays readable while the button shows.”
  • S3-R14: “Include the lead technician action in the card’s more-actions menu: “Assign lead technician” on a work order with no lead technician, “Reassign lead technician” on one that has a lead technician.”
  • S4-R4: “The card or row more-actions menu opens the lead technician dialog, titled “Assign lead technician” or “Reassign lead technician” to match the menu item it was opened from (S3-R14).”
  • S4-N6: “On an Invoiced or Paid work order the Assign lead technician or Reassign lead technician action (S3-R14) and the Unassign action are disabled, and their tooltip reads “Invoiced · can’t be reassigned” or “Paid · can’t be reassigned”, as in the design. The same words are the tooltip on the card’s or row’s lock icon, and the note shown at the top of another technician’s column or group while the work order is dragged over it, where the drop is refused.”
  • Design — Work Orders.dc.html, more-actions menu: “transform: translateX(-100%); width: 216px; padding: 4px; border-radius: var(--sv-radius-md); background: var(--sv-surface);”

AUTOMATION: READY
